svg.title: Figure 4 | A Reliable Agent Work Cycle
svg.desc: Downward arrows indicate work order. After confirming new decisions, update the authoritative specification for the next task. This feedback is stated explicitly; it does not happen automatically after execution.

g.font-family: Arial, Noto Sans CJK TC, sans-serif
g.text: Figure 4 | A Reliable Agent Work Cycle
Include correct documents, code and necessary evidence
Read, analyze, modify and run tools
Confirm specification compliance using actual results
